# Timeless Investments

> > Fractional ownership platform for luxury collectibles including watches, whisky, wine, and art, starting from €50.

Timeless Investments is a Switzerland-based alternative investment platform enabling fractional ownership of authenticated luxury assets. Backed by SevenVentures and featured in Knight Frank Wealth Report, the platform offers access to limited-edition collectibles from brands like Audemars Piguet, Rolex, Patek Philippe, and Macallan.

## Marketplace & Platform

- [Buy fractions in exclusive and actual collectibles — Timeless](https://www.timeless.investments/en/assets): Main marketplace for fractional collectibles from €50 (watches, art, wine)
- [Gift Vouchers](https://www.timeless.investments/en/vouchers): Gift vouchers for fractional collectible investments
- [Timeless Magazine](https://www.timeless.investments/en/magazine): Expert articles on luxury collectibles, market updates & investment guides
